exposure: Vaginal Birth After Previous Cesarean Section (VBAC)
cohort: The study included 100 postpartum women, comprising 50 who underwent VBAC and 50 who underwent elective repeated cesarean sections.
finding: VBAC patients demonstrated significantly higher satisfaction across all quality-of-life domains compared to those who had repeated cesarean sections.
mod_finding: VBAC was associated with better functioning, higher socioeconomic stability, stronger social and emotional support, improved psychological well-being, and enhanced health outcomes compared to repeated cesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Postpartum, data collected between April 2024 to December 2024.
